html:
G'oya

Voronka bosqichlari zanjir: har bosqich oldingisiga bog'liq. Shuning uchun har bosqichni alohida CTE qilamiz. Har birida oldingi bosqichga kirganlar va ularning kirish vaqti t bor. Keyingi bosqichga faqat ular o'ta oladi, va faqat t dan keyingi harakat bilan. Har CTE'dagi qatorlar soni shu bosqichdagi foydalanuvchilar soni. Oxirida to'rtta sonni to'rt qatorga yozib, ulushni LAG bilan hisoblaymiz.

Yechim

WITH v AS (
  SELECT student_id, MIN(created_at) AS t
  FROM events
  WHERE event_type = 'visit'
  GROUP BY student_id
),
s AS (
  SELECT v.student_id, MIN(e.created_at) AS t
  FROM v
  JOIN events e ON e.student_id = v.student_id
               AND e.event_type = 'signup' AND e.created_at >= v.t
  GROUP BY v.student_id
),
en AS (
  SELECT s.student_id, MIN(e.created_at) AS t
  FROM s
  JOIN events e ON e.student_id = s.student_id
               AND e.event_type = 'enroll' AND e.created_at >= s.t
  GROUP BY s.student_id
),
p AS (
  SELECT en.student_id, MIN(e.created_at) AS t
  FROM en
  JOIN events e ON e.student_id = en.student_id
               AND e.event_type = 'pay' AND e.created_at >= en.t
  GROUP BY en.student_id
),
counts AS (
  SELECT 1 AS pos, 'visit' AS step, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v) AS students
  UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'signup', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s)
  UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'enroll', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM en)
  UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'pay', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p)
)
SELECT step, students,
       ROUND(100.0 * students / NULLIF(LAG(students) OVER (ORDER BY pos), 0), 1) AS conversion_pct
FROM counts
ORDER BY pos

counts qatorlari skalyar subquery'lardan tuzilgan, shuning uchun jadval bo'sh bo'lsa ham to'rtta qator bor. NULLIF(..., 0) nolga bo'lishning oldini oladi: maxraj NULL bo'lsa, ulush ham NULL. pos ustuni bosqichlar tartibini saqlaydi, uni step nomi bo'yicha saralab bo'lmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Faqat harakat borligini tekshirish yetmaydi. Namunadagi 4-foydalanuvchi avval ro'yxatdan o'tgan, keyin saytga kirgan: u signup bosqichida sanalmaydi.

Har harakatning birinchi vaqtini olib, ularni solishtirish ham xato. 2-testdagi 7-foydalanuvchi soat 9:00 da signup, 10:00 da visit, ertasiga yana signup qilgan. Birinchi signup birinchi visit dan oldin, lekin ikkinchisi keyin, va u bosqichdan o'tgan.

Ulush oldingi bosqichga nisbatan, birinchisiga emas. Namunada 5 kishi kirgan, 3 tasi ro'yxatdan o'tgan (60.0), ulardan 2 tasi kursga yozilgan (66.7), 1 tasi to'lagan (50.0).

Boshqa yo'l

Bitta qatorga to'rtta vaqtni korrelyatsiyalangan subquery'lar bilan yig'ib, keyin COUNT(t2), COUNT(t3) kabi sanash ham mumkin: COUNT NULL larni sanamaydi. Bu yechim qisqaroq ko'rinadi, lekin har foydalanuvchi uchun uchta qo'shimcha so'rov bajariladi. Indeks bo'lmasa katta jadvalda sekin.
